issues.on_page: HUD capital fund grants 52,228; Loss on capital asset dispositions (9)
issues.issue: The extractor moved the nonoperating loss on dispositions (9) out of receipts and into other_financing alongside capital contributions. That's defensible (sale/disposal of assets), but it means reported_totals receipts 135,017 is a computed figure that doesn't match the printed nonoperating total 62,506 + operating 72,502 = 135,008.
